Starting strategy supplied by the researcher and identical for every run; you did not write it. It is deliberately simple. Judge it on the evidence like any other version.
def decide(bars, account):
    """Buy on the first decision while flat, then hold without selling."""
    if account["position"] <= 0 and account["cash"] > 0:
        return "BUY", "buy-and-hold seed: enter while flat"
    return "HOLD", "buy-and-hold seed: retain the position"
